description: The file defines the ConfigBuilder class used to construct and manage configuration instances for the Daux documentation generation tool. It includes methods for loading configuration files, overriding values, theme resolution, and initialization routines.

classes.name: ConfigBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and customizing Config objects for Daux, supporting chaining of configuration options and handling theme and path resolution.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Loads a Config object from a given serialized file.

methods.name: withMode
methods.description: Creates a ConfigBuilder with a specific mode and loads the base configuration.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Merges an array of values into the current configuration.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value within a nested Config array based on dot notation key.

methods.name: withValues
methods.description: Overrides configuration values with provided key-value pairs.

methods.name: withDocumentationDirectory
methods.description: Sets the documentation directory in the configuration.

methods.name: withValidContentExtensions
methods.description: Specifies valid file extensions for content files.

methods.name: withThemesPath
methods.description: Sets the path for themes.

methods.name: withThemesDirectory
methods.description: Sets the themes directory.

methods.name: withCache
methods.description: Enables or disables caching.

methods.name: withFormat
methods.description: Sets the output format.

methods.name: withConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Sets an override configuration file.

methods.name: withProcessor
methods.description: Sets the processor configuration.

methods.name: withConfluenceDelete
methods.description: Configures whether to delete pages in Confluence.

methods.name: withConfluencePrintDiff
methods.description: Configures whether to print diffs during Confluence sync.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the Config object after applying all overrides and initializations.

methods.name: resolveThemeVariant
methods.description: Resolves theme and variant based on theme directory structure.

methods.name: initializeConfiguration
methods.description: Performs initial validation and loading of configurations, including theme paths and override files.

methods.name: normalizeThemePath
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the theme path.

methods.name: normalizeDocumentationPath
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the documentation path.

methods.name: loadBaseConfiguration
methods.description: Loads the default base configuration settings.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads a JSON configuration file into the current configuration.

methods.name: getConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Retrieves an override configuration file path if available.

methods.name: findLocation
methods.description: Locates a directory or file based on relative or absolute paths.
